summary: Publish files as a new drop and return its permanent URL.

options.description: Short human name of the drop (200 bytes max), shown in lists and on the password page. Always set it.
Your own JSON notes on the drop (16 KB max): what it is, where the data came from, who it was sent to. Returned by get, never shown to visitors.

"generate" for a random 16-character password returned once, in this response; a chosen password of at least 8 characters; or null for none. On the command line only "generate"; a chosen one goes on stdin with --password-stdin.
When the link stops working: "7d", "2026-12-31", an RFC 3339 instant, or "never".
Tell search engines to stay away (default true).

Optional: choose the drop's path segment (3-40 characters of a-z 0-9 and -) for a link a human will read, like a campaign URL; omitted, one is generated. It can never be changed, and a slug already in use is SLUG_TAKEN.
A key you choose; a retry with the same key and payload returns the same result instead of acting twice.
Read the password from stdin (one line), so it stays out of argv.

summary: Change only the fields given; files replace the whole set.

options.description: Short human name of the drop (200 bytes max), shown in lists and on the password page. Always set it. null removes it. --no-title clears it.
Your own JSON notes on the drop (16 KB max): what it is, where the data came from, who it was sent to. Returned by get, never shown to visitors. Merged at the top level; a key set to null is removed.

"generate" for a random 16-character password returned once, in this response; a chosen password of at least 8 characters; or null for none. null removes it; re-sending the current one changes nothing. On the command line only "generate"; a chosen one goes on stdin with --password-stdin.
When the link stops working: "7d", "2026-12-31", an RFC 3339 instant, or "never".
Tell search engines to stay away (default true).
A key you choose; a retry with the same key and payload returns the same result instead of acting twice.
Read the password from stdin (one line), so it stays out of argv.

summary: Read a drop; with files, its text content comes back inline.

options.description: Also return the text files' content inline (1 MB in total; the rest by download_url).

summary: One page of this instance's drops, newest first.

options.description: Rows per page, 1 to 1000 (default 100).
The cursor of the previous page, to continue from it.
A case-insensitive substring of the title, matched within the page.

summary: Delete a drop and its files immediately.
Add a person: mint their key once and return how to connect them.

summary: List every key of this instance: id, label, scope and creation date.
Remove a person: their key stops working immediately.
Read this instance's policy: the defaults it fills in and the rules it enforces.
Change policy fields; the change applies to future calls only.
Count the drops and the bytes this instance holds, per state.
